title: Pineapple Tart Adventure Bites
description: Sweet and tangy bites of pineapple and tart pastry, perfect for a snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll out tart pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Cut into 1-inch squares.
In a small bowl, mix together sugar, melted butter, and beaten egg.
Place a spoonful of pineapple onto one half of each square, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Brush edges with water and fold the other half of the pastry square over the filling.
Press edges to seal and use a fork to crimp. Cut a small slit in the top of each bite.
Place on prepared baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow to cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
